title: Assessment of CCM in HF With Higher Ejection Fraction
official: Assessment of Implantable CCM in the Heart Failure Group With Higher Ejection Fraction
summary: The AIM HIGHer Clinical Trial will evaluate the safety and efficacy of Cardiac Contractility Modulation (CCM) therapy in patients with heart failure with LVEF ≥40% and ≤70%.
